observations.why: Ratifying a contract on the grounds that work is never lost and calls never block appeals to stability/conservation and to craft-quality/competence as the goods the design delivers.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Framing the decision as the agent choosing its own retrieval cadence — poll now or receive later — appeals to self-origination/autonomy and to the capability to manage the run/competence.
